{{Quote|Admiral! A Sith Imperial fleet is dropping out of hyperspace&mdash;right on top of us!|[[Te Corso]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref>}}
The '''First Coruscant Task Force''' was a detachment of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] loyal to the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Krion Grail]], the Task Force [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|ambushed]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Admiral [[Gar Stazi]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|defense fleet]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

The Task Force's flagship was the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Marauder (Ardent-class)|''Marauder'']].
